name: 360 Construction & Roofing

hero.title: High quality work,
hero.lead: We are Gonzalo “Charlie” Rios and Victor Rios, owners of 360 Construction & Roofing. We handle everything from pre-construction planning to project management, for residential and commercial projects across Baytown.
hero.imageAlt: A brick home with a gabled, timber-framed patio cover built by 360 Construction & Roofing

services.title: Roof Repair
services.short: Small repairs handled by our own roofers.
services.text: From small repairs to complete replacements, our roofers handle the whole range, using the same quality materials on a patch as on a new roof.
body: Our roofing services cover everything from small repairs to complete replacements. The same crew that installs new roofs does the repair work, so the fix is made with the materials and the care we would put into a full job.
We take pride in our attention to detail, making sure every repair is done right the first time.
points: Shingle, tile and metal roof repair

services.title: Roof Replacement
services.short: A complete new roof in shingle, tile or metal.
services.text: A complete roof replacement in the material you pick, installed by our own roofers with the highest quality materials for lasting durability and protection.
body: When a roof is past repairing, we replace it. You choose the material, shingle, tile or metal, and our roofers install it with the quality materials we have built our name on.
Our commitment is to superior workmanship and lasting durability, so the roof protects the property for its full life. Book a free 30-minute consultation and we will walk the property with you first.
points: Shingle, tile and metal roof installation

services.title: Shingle Roofs
services.short: Shingle roof installation for homes and businesses.
services.text: Shingle roof installation for residential and commercial properties, done by expert roofers who use only the highest quality materials.
body: Shingle is the roof most Baytown homes wear, and it is the one we install most often. Our team installs it on residential and commercial properties alike.
We install Owens Corning shingles and supply our jobs through ABC Supply.

services.title: Metal Roofs
services.short: Metal roof installation built to last.
services.text: Metal roof installation for residential and commercial properties, chosen for lasting durability and protection.
body: A metal roof is a long commitment, so it is worth having installed properly. Our expert roofers install metal for homes and for commercial buildings.
As with every roof we put on, we use only the highest quality materials and check the detail work before we call the job done.

services.title: Tile Roofs
services.short: Tile roof installation, residential and commercial.
services.text: Tile roof installation for residential and commercial properties, installed with the attention to detail every tile roof needs.
body: Tile is one of the four roof types our team installs, alongside shingle, TPO and metal. It rewards careful work, and careful work is what we sell.
Ask for a free 30-minute consultation and one of our experts will come out to the property.

services.title: Kitchen Remodeling
services.short: Kitchens planned and built from concept to completion.
services.text: Kitchen remodels taken from concept to completion, with personalized solutions worked out with you before anything is torn out.
services.imageAlt: A remodeled white kitchen with a large island and stainless appliances
body: A kitchen remodel touches plumbing, electrical, cabinetry, counters and floors, and it is the room a family misses most while it is down. We handle the pre-construction planning and the project management so the trades arrive in the right order.
We work closely with our clients to understand their goals and deliver customized solutions, using only the best materials and techniques.

services.title: Bathroom Remodeling
services.short: Bathroom remodels managed end to end.
services.text: Bathroom remodels with the project management and craftsmanship our clients name in their reviews.
services.imageAlt: A remodeled bathroom with a double vanity and framed mirrors
body: Bathrooms are small rooms with a lot of trades in them. We plan the sequence first, then manage every trade through to completion so the work does not stall halfway.
One of our clients put it this way about their bathroom remodel: excellent project management and craftsmanship skills from all trades building our project.

services.title: Home Remodeling
services.text: Remodeling for homes of any size, handled from pre-construction planning through to project management and completion.
services.imageAlt: A remodeled kitchen with a window over the sink looking onto a lawn
body: Construction projects can be complex and challenging, often involving multiple parties and strict timelines. We specialize in handling everything from pre-construction planning to project management, so every part of the job runs smoothly.
Whether you are looking to upgrade your home or your business, we have the expertise to tackle any project, big or small.

services.title: Home Additions
services.short: Adding the room your house is missing.
services.text: Additions designed and built with you, from the first drawing to the last inspection.
body: An addition is a construction project in its own right: planning, permits, foundation, framing, roof and finish. We run all of it, working closely with you to make sure your vision becomes reality.
Book a free 30-minute consultation at your home and one of our experts will talk through what is possible.

services.title: Flooring
services.short: New floors as part of a remodel or on their own.
services.text: Flooring installed with the same attention to detail we bring to every part of a project.
body: Flooring is one of the services our clients ask for most, whether as part of a larger remodel or on its own.
We use only the best materials and techniques, and we will give you an honest view of what suits the room before you commit.

services.title: Siding
services.short: Siding that protects and changes the whole look.
services.text: Siding installation for homes and businesses, using quality materials chosen for the Gulf Coast.
body: New siding does two jobs at once: it protects the structure behind it and it changes the look of the whole building.
We install Allura fiber cement siding.

services.title: Painting
services.text: Painting as part of a remodel or as a project of its own, finished to the standard we hold every trade to.
body: Paint is the last thing anyone sees and the first thing they judge, so we treat the prep as seriously as the finish coat.
We work with Sherwin-Williams paint.

services.title: Patios
services.short: Covered patios and outdoor living space.
services.text: Patios built to be used, from a simple cover to a full outdoor living space.
services.imageAlt: A covered patio with stone columns and exposed timber beams
body: A patio is where a Texas house gets its extra room. We build the structure, the roof over it and the finishes under it as one project.
From concept to completion, we work closely with our clients to make sure the space turns out the way they pictured it.

services.title: Concrete
services.short: Concrete work for new builds and remodels.
services.text: Concrete work for slabs, drives and the groundwork under the rest of a project.
body: Concrete is where most of our larger projects start, and getting it right saves trouble in every stage after it.
We handle it as part of a project or as a job on its own, for residential and commercial properties.

services.title: Restoration
services.short: Putting a damaged property back together.
services.text: Restoration work that brings a damaged or worn property back, with our own project management holding the trades together.
body: Restoration is rarely one trade. It usually needs a contractor who can plan the sequence and hold several trades to it, which is the part of the work we specialize in.
We have a proven track record of delivering high-quality projects on time and on budget.

services.title: TPO and Flat Roofs
services.text: TPO roof installation for commercial properties, one of the four roof systems our expert roofers install.
body: TPO is the roof most low-slope commercial buildings want, and our roofers install it alongside shingle, tile and metal.
We install Mule-Hide low-slope roofing products. Our commitment is to superior workmanship and lasting durability, so the building stays protected.

services.title: Build Outs
services.short: Commercial build outs from concept to completion.
services.text: Commercial build outs run from pre-construction planning through project management to a finished, usable space.
body: A build out runs on a timeline someone else set, usually a lease. We handle the pre-construction planning and the project management so the dates hold.
Our team of highly skilled professionals delivers personalized solutions for commercial projects, big or small.

materials.title: Brands and materials we work with
materials.text: The manufacturers and suppliers behind the work we install.

about.title: Charlie and Victor Rios, and the crew behind them
text: Hi, we are Gonzalo “Charlie” Rios and Victor Rios, owners of 360 Construction & Roofing. Construction projects can be complex and challenging, often involving multiple parties and strict timelines.

At 360 Construction & Roofing we specialize in handling everything from pre-construction planning to project management, making sure every aspect of the project runs smoothly and efficiently. We work closely with our clients to understand their goals and deliver customized solutions.

We have a proven track record of delivering high-quality projects on time and on budget, attention to detail, and a commitment to communication and collaboration with our clients and partners. If you are planning a construction project, let's schedule a consultation to discuss your needs and how we can help.
about.imageAlt: Two members of the 360 Construction & Roofing team going over plans on site

facts.heading: Financing
facts.text: We make it easy to pay for the projects you need. Ask us about our financing options.

facts.heading: Free Consultation
facts.text: Book a free 30-minute consultation at your home with one of our experts to help you decide if we're the right residential general contractor for you. You'll have the opportunity to see our work, ask questions, and get personalized recommendations.

facts.heading: Residential and Commercial
facts.text: Our construction, remodeling and roofing services cover both residential and commercial properties, and we have the expertise to tackle any project, big or small.

facts.heading: What a customer said
facts.text: “360 CONSTRUCTION planned, and executed our bathroom remodel flawlessly!! Excellent project management and craftsmanship skills from all trades building our project. We also noticed the customers service was outstanding.” Gabriel Estrada, Baytown.
